category_edits.rationale: Initialize tied item embeddings with standard deviation hidden_units**-0.5 to reduce initial BCE logit saturation and balance scaled item embeddings with positional embeddings across all four datasets. The predictor imports the same SASRec class and loads trained weights, so no predictor change is required.

response.change_summary: Change only item-embedding initialization from Normal(0, 1) to Normal(0, hidden_units**-0.5). Preserve the SASRec backbone, tied embeddings, training settings, seeds, routing, and one checkpoint per category.
